Variant of: Militech Ticon
Cost: 375eb (Expensive)
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Medium Pistol
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Ironfake variant: an Exotic, Poor Quality bootleg of the listed original. Every BODY requirement of the original goes up by 1. Can't be bought through the Edgerunners Mission Kit option of paying double to skip the Fixer. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

Every shot fires a 3-round burst. While the Tech Rebuild is charged it's ROF 1 and deals 4d6. (Corgo describes this as +1d6, but the base Ticon is 2d6, so check the total with your GM.) +2 to Conceal/Reveal Object checks to hide it under clothing.

Foundry notes:

  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
